heading: You're already spending money creating reasons for customers to visit. We make those reasons visible, relevant and discoverable so your investment works harder.
subhead:
Broadcast packages are expensive with monthly or per event cost. Musicians, comedians, and quizmasters are paid   whether the room has three or three hundred attendees.
Venues often only manage to activate that spend on a day when it barely needs the help.

contrast.title: Already full
contrast.text: The room's busy either way — word of mouth, habit, a big fixture. Audeohost adds atmosphere here, not attendance. Nice, but it isn't where the growth is.

contrast.title: Already paid for. Empty anyway.
contrast.text: Three fans, house music, a screen nobody can actually hear. Same broadcast line-item as Saturday. Zero extra cost to give those three real commentary — and a reason for the next three to start showing up.

beatStrip: You can't fill an already-full room. You can turn the nights it's empty into a reason to come back — using sport and entertainment you've already paid for, no matter what night it falls on.
